note: Finals pass reuses the two-stage i2v graph. Planned dims and width/height describe the UNCROPPED generated raster, divisible by 64; latent(8) and ImageScale(31) take half, divisible by 32. The x2 latent upsampler(21) restores that raster. Delivery-crop metadata is not a graph input: composition fits/crops the generated file downstream. Feeding a 1920x1080 delivery size to this graph would create an invalid 960x540 base. Frames remain 8n+1; fps reaches conditioning, empty audio and the output container. The runner uploads the start image. Stage-1 and stage-2 image strengths remain separate controls.
